newsitem.title: USA: Union sees 1,125 MW nuke on line Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Union sees 1,125 MW nuke on line Wednesday.

text.p: Union Electric Co expected its 1,125 megawatt (MW) Callaway nuclear power station to go on line Wednesday after being manually shut Sunday to repair a leaking seal in a hydraulic system.
"The plant will be back up Wednesday night," said a company spokeswoman.
The hydraulic system, which operates one of the main feedwater valves, is in the reactor's secondary containment area.
The Fulton, Mo., plant represents about 25 percent of the company's installed generation capacity.
Callaway is one of nine generating stations owned and operated by Union Electric.
